backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only an earnings snapshot and OHLCV known after the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day earnings snapshot fields, same-day/trailing OHLCV fields, and next-open/exit prices available to replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: pre-earnings names with repeat positive historical surprise and current RS may attract positioning before or through the earnings event.

2_history_check.exp-20260428-017: Observed-only audit on existing A/B candidates used near earnings + positive surprise > 0; this run tests an additive paper candidate pool with stricter surprise-history and RS/trend requirements.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-027_and_028: PEAD residual/no-residual tests rejected post-earnings 5d hypotheses. This run is pre-event positioning, not a PEAD-window retry.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-007: Revision magnitude failed as a 5d clue. This run does not use estimate revision magnitude.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Pre-earnings candidates with positive historical EPS surprise tendency and same-day RS/trend confirmation may form a production-visible default-off paper candidate pool.
interpretation: The pre-earnings surprise-history RS sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby earnings-window or surprise-history thresholds on these frozen windows without forward rows or a materially different pre-event field.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, use forward replacement-value rows, a true multi-season pre-earnings cohort, or a materially different pre-event expectation field such as revenue estimate velocity with analyst-count confirmation.

source_definition: earnings snapshot exists for the signal date
at least 3 historical surprise observations are positive

prediction.confidence_reason: This is distinct from PEAD/revision tests because it uses pre-event surprise-history context, but nearby earnings and expectation families have been weak.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter plus parity tests before any daily report, watchlist, or live/default behavior changes.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe attribution remains sparse; skipped Companyfacts/VBB/VCP/state-surface/Space threshold retunes per playbook freeze guidance; skipped PEAD 5d retests because recent repaired-field experiments rejected that horizon. This run tests one pre-event free earnings snapshot field plus OHLCV confirmation.
